items.title: Ray Bryant interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: I met — I can’t even begin to say how many people I met as a result of being sort of like the Blue Note house trio. Charlie Parker was one, Sonny Stitt, Roy Eldridge, Charlie Shavers.

ctx.x: Was this a gig that was something that was a pretty good gig to grab?

Well at that time I guess so. It wasn’t much money to be made or anything like that, but as far as meeting people whom I heard only on records, it was just great and getting a chance to work with them. The Blue Note club, lots of guys came to play there without accompaniment. They came alone, and so it was up to the club to provide back-up for them, back-up musicians and I was lucky enough to be called in quite a few cases. I met — I can’t even begin to say how many people I met as a result of being sort of like…
